channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, AI, Tech & Research, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, AI, Tech & Research, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Realities in Transition RiT2 Open Call #3: Uncharted Grounds, a VRChat world residency with L.E.V. Festival (EUR 10,000 fee plus up to EUR 15,000 production)
item.description: Realities in Transition (RiT2, Creative Europe), with L.E.V. Festival · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 gross artist fee per selected artist (paid in three instalments) plus up to EUR 15,000 gross production budget shared among the team. No travel or accommodation included. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: Schaufler Residency@TU Dresden 2027 (six-month art and science residency, Energy Cultures in Transition)
item.description: Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden (TUD Dresden University of Technology and The Schaufler Foundation) · deadline 09 Nov 2026 · Fellowship of EUR 3,000 net per month for six months (EUR 18,000), plus a production grant of up to EUR 10,000 for a solo exhibition at the TUD University Gallery in autumn 2027, a studio on campus and help finding accommodation. No application fee.

item.title: TRACES Art & Science @ Energypolis 2027: residency at the EPFL Laboratory for Energy Materials (Sion)
item.description: Foundation for the Sustainable Development of Mountain Regions (FDDM) with EPFL Valais-Wallis · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · Artist stipend of CHF 2,000 per month (CHF 6,000 total) covering living and research costs, housing in Sion, travel from home and back up to CHF 1,500, and a separate production budget set by the curator. No application fee.

item.title: HIAP: Learning Materials International Artist Residency 2027 (Suomenlinna, Helsinki)
item.description: HIAP (Helsinki International Artist Programme), with Kone Foundation · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · Working grant of EUR 1,350 per month (EUR 4,050 total for 90 days) via Kone Foundation, material budget up to EUR 750, access budget up to EUR 1,000, one return trip covered (slow travel encouraged), plus accommodation and workspace. For collectives, the working grant can be paid to one individual only and there is no additional travel budget.

item.title: Art Explora x Cité internationale des arts Residency, 7th Call (Paris)
item.description: Art Explora Foundation and Cité internationale des arts · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,000 per month living stipend plus up to EUR 3,000 production grant, a furnished live-work studio of around 50 m2 at the Cité internationale des arts, round-trip travel to Paris and curatorial mentoring. No application fee.

item.title: OASis Bom Dia Residency 2027 at Cultivamos Cultura (Sao Luis, Portugal)
item.description: Cultivamos Cultura (European OASis project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,300 project fee, travel budget up to EUR 500, production and material expenses up to EUR 1,600 (pre-approved), food per diem, plus free accommodation in a private room in a shared farmhouse and access to a workspace or studio and all Cultivamos Cultura spaces and resources.

item.title: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships 2027/28 (Lisbon)
item.description: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study (GIAS), Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to 15 fellowships a year. Each covers travel costs, travel and health insurance, a monthly stipend and a partial housing subsidy; the stipend level is set at selection based on CV and length of stay. No application fee.

item.title: UNIDEE Residency Programs: Visiting Research Curator 2027-28
item.description: Fondazione Pistoletto Cittadellarte and UNIDEE Residency Programs · deadline 13 Sep 2026 · Compensation and contractual terms commensurate with the candidate's level of professional experience, starting from a gross amount of EUR 22,000 for the appointment, excluding travel and hospitality, which are covered separately. No application fee.

item.title: CTM Festival: Resynthesising the Traditional 2027 Artistic Lab (At the Extreme)
item.description: CTM Festival, co-curated by Stas Sharifulla · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · Travel budget of up to EUR 300 per person, plus accommodation and catering for the duration of the lab and a festival pass to CTM 2027 events. Visa fees are supported where required, and letters of invitation are provided for visa or funding applications. NO artist fee or stipend for the lab itself. Afterwards, up to two new works arising from the lab may be commissioned and presented at CTM Festival in January/February 2028. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research residency - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Numeric 2026: The Word (Les antipodes Research and Creation Residency)
    https://lesantipodes.com/numeric/2026_bases_en.html
    Les antipodes, with Bolit Centre d'Art Contemporani Girona and Museu de l'Emporda Figueres · deadline 08 Sep 2026 · Two grants. Each provides a stipend of EUR 1,000 as taxable base (taxes and withholdings apply), round-trip travel within the European Union, and accommodation and meals for the four weeks in Agullana. Travel and meals cover the resident only, though the shared apartment can host immediate family by arrangement. Numeric also provides the resources specified in the application and agreed during preparation. No application fee. Note that if a selected candidate lacks the professional registration needed to receive the stipend and payment has to be arranged through Les antipodes, the resulting costs are deducted from the stipend.

item.title: 4 new AI, Tech & Research residencies - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Residing Non-linear Technologies and Sonic Worldings (M-Cult x Titanik, Helsinki and Turku)
    https://www.titanik.fi/residency-open-call-residing-non-linear-technologies-and-sonic-worldings/
    Art and Media Culture Agency M-Cult (Helsinki) and Arte artists' association / Titanik gallery (Turku) · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,500 artist fee plus EUR 2,000 production budget, two months' accommodation split between Helsinki and Turku, and one return travel ticket from a Nordic-Baltic country. No application fee stated.
  • DRIFT: Choreographer Open Call 2026-27 (Dance and Research In The Future Time)
    https://driftdance.eu/artists/open-call
    DRIFT, a four-year Creative Europe cooperation of ten organisations led by Theatre de Liege and Maison de la danse · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · EUR 20,000 research budget per choreographer, covering artistic fees, travel, accommodation and optional collaborator costs. Also included: an Onboarding Lab, two weeks of residency with your national DRIFT partner, three collaborative Online Labs, a Festival Lab in Tunis, individual artistic mentoring and individual curatorial mentoring, and a work-in-progress presentation at the Biennale de la danse in Lyon. No application fee.
  • American Academy in Berlin: Berlin Prize Fellowship 2027-28
    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/
    American Academy in Berlin · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 5,000, plus roundtrip airfare, accommodation at or near the Hans Arnhold Center, partial board, in-house library services and professional networking opportunities. Roughly two dozen fellowships awarded each year. No application fee.
  • Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research residency - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-videotage
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Videotage, Hong Kong · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for a two-month residency or EUR 6,500 for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL to cover travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Accommodation, use of the studio space and facilitation by Videotage are covered directly by the Fund on top of this. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research residency - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• transmediale x Pro Helvetia Digital Art Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/digital-art-residency-2027
    transmediale (in cooperation with the Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia) · deadline 28 Aug 2026 · Artist fee of CHF 2,000 per month across the two-month residency (CHF 4,000), plus a production grant of CHF 15,000 for the selected project, plus travel and accommodation for both the festival and the residency month. Duos and collectives may apply but the fee and the production grant stay the same and must be shared. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research residency - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Medialab Matadero: Situated Research Residencies 2027 (Madrid)
    https://www.medialab-matadero.es/en/announcements/situated-research-2027
    Medialab Matadero · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · EUR 10,000 per project (before taxes) for three selected projects, plus individual workspace, Fablab and technical materials, curatorial guidance, and logistical and financial support for public activities. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research residency - week of 22 Jun 2026
item.description:
• KB Researcher-in-Residence (RiR) 2027
    https://lab.kb.nl/news/call-kb-researcher-residence-rir-2027
    KB, National Library of the Netherlands · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · Secondment at 0.5 FTE for 6 months based on your current salary, up to EUR 5,590 gross per month for a full-time-equivalent position, plus travel expenses, office facilities, and support from a research software engineer, research advisor, and collection and data specialists. No application fee.
